answer: Demand signed recreational fishing licence catch log with wildlife agency attestation at the door. The wildlife agency signs the licence's catch log across a season of distinct dates. A farm needs one licensed angler per copy, and a licence with no logged trips has no record to vouch for. An honest agent clears the cipher once; a farm must clear the haven for every copy it runs, so the wharf it can keep is the reward minus a bill that arrives per copy.
